_meta.name: avoenix-task-methods
_meta.note: Hand-authored hierarchical-task-network methods: a goal verb + object class decomposes into ordered subtasks with a share of the available time. This is a small knowledge base, not learned behaviour; goals with no method are reported as unsupported rather than improvised.

subtasks.text: List everything the {object} covers and mark the topics you find hardest
Study the hardest topics first, in short focused sessions with breaks
Practise under realistic conditions, using past questions or a mock {object}, and time yourself
Review what you got wrong and condense the key points onto one page
Get your materials ready, sleep well and keep the last hours light
Decide what the {object} needs and write the list down
Book or buy the things that have the longest lead time first
Arrange the details and confirm with everyone involved
Do a final check of the list and handle anything left over
Define what being able to do {object} means for you, in one sentence
Learn the basics with one good resource rather than many
Practise a little every day and apply it to a small real task
Get feedback, fix the weakest part and repeat
